news.title: Hyde-Smith Blocked Colom’s Path to the Bench. Now He’s Replacing Her.
news.summary: Ms. Hyde-Smith, a Republican, blocked Scott Colom from consideration for a U.S. District Court vacancy in Mississippi. Mr. Colom will take her Senate seat in January.
